goal: Connect a Windows client to the isolated VMnet2 lab network, validate DHCP addressing and default gateway assignment, test LAN gateway reachability, record DNS configuration and identify any remaining client connectivity issues.
definition_of_done: Windows client connected to VMnet2, DHCP lease and subnet verified, default gateway confirmed as 192.168.20.1, DNS configuration recorded, gateway connectivity tested, results and limitations documented, next technical action identified.
dependencies: OPNsense VM must remain available, VMware Adapter 2 must remain connected to VMnet2, OPNsense LAN must remain assigned to em1 at 192.168.20.1/24, DHCP service and pool 192.168.20.100–192.168.20.199 must be available, Windows client VM must be identified before changing its network adapter, existing domain controller NS-DC01 must remain untouched.
tech_context: VMware Workstation, OPNsense 26.7, firewall VM FW-OPNsense01, WAN em0 on VMnet8 with DHCP address 192.168.148.129/24, LAN em1 on VMnet2 at 192.168.20.1/24, VMware NAT gateway 192.168.148.2, intended client subnet 192.168.20.0/24, Windows client VM to be identified, repository branch main.
